Whirlpool Cocoon.name: Whirlpool Cocoon
Whirlpool Cocoon.description: The user wraps a person, themselves included, in a thick, turning shell of water with air inside. Until the end of the user's next turn, blows, blades and bullets slow to a shove against it, and fire, heat, smoke and gas cannot reach the person inside; thrown under someone falling, the shell catches them unhurt. Strain: moderate.
